plugins.photosPermission: VOLA uses your photos so you can attach a progress picture to a check-in. Pictures stay private to your account and are never shown to anyone else.
plugins.cameraPermission: VOLA uses the camera so you can photograph a meal to estimate it, photograph a gym machine to identify it, or scan a barcode off a food packet. A photo is sent to VOLA to be read and is not stored; a barcode is decoded on your phone and never leaves it.
